seo.title: Oltin Uy — jewellery house in Tashkent: rings and bespoke gold
seo.description: Engagement and wedding rings, earrings and necklaces in 14k and 18k gold with diamonds. Our own workshop: bespoke pieces, engraving, repairs.
seo.answer: Oltin Uy is a jewellery house with its own workshop in Tashkent: 14k gold wedding rings from 2,900,000 UZS a pair, diamond engagement rings from 9,500,000 UZS, a piece to your own sketch from 3 weeks. Every diamond piece comes with a stone certificate.

listing.description: A website for a jewellery house, watch boutique or jewellery salon. Night velvet with a gold sheen in WebGL, a rotating ring with a stone, collections in a vitrine under a spotlight and a gallery in arched niches.

sections.title: Gold that remembers
sections.subtitle: Engagement rings, collections and pieces made to your sketch. Every piece is assembled and polished by hand in our workshop behind the boutique wall.

sections.label: The house
sections.title: A family workshop that became a house
sections.text: Oltin Uy began with one workbench and two jeweller brothers in the old city. Today we have a boutique on Amir Temur and a six-bench workshop where every piece goes from wax model to final polish. We choose stones ourselves and show them under a loupe before you buy, and every piece gets free cleaning for life.

items.title: A piece to your sketch
items.text: We draw it, make a 3D model and a wax prototype to try on, then cast it in gold.

items.title: Choosing a diamond
items.text: We show three or four certified stones within your budget and explain the difference.

items.title: Engraving
items.text: Names, dates, a fingerprint or handwriting — laser and hand engraving.

items.title: Resizing and repairs
items.text: We resize, rebuild prongs and replace clasps — including on pieces from other jewellers.

items.title: Cleaning and polishing
items.text: Ultrasonic cleaning and polishing for Oltin Uy jewellery — free, for life.

items.label: for a piece to your sketch

items.title: Meeting
items.text: We discuss the idea, try on samples and choose the metal.

items.title: Sketch and 3D
items.text: We draw it and show the model from every side.

items.title: Wax fitting
items.text: A wax prototype on your finger — we adjust before casting.

items.quote: We brought my grandmother's old ring, and its gold became two wedding bands. Her handwriting is engraved inside — I still can't look at it without tears.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: They showed me four diamonds under a loupe and told me honestly what I'd be overpaying for. The ring was ready in three weeks, just in time for the engagement.
items.author: Timur

items.q: How much is a wedding ring?
items.a: A pair of plain 14k gold wedding rings starts at 2,900,000 UZS; the total depends on weight and width. We fix the price in the contract before making them.
Yes. Stones from 0.3 carat come with a gemmological lab certificate; smaller ones with a product passport.

items.q: How long does a bespoke piece take?
items.a: Usually 3 to 5 weeks: a week for the sketch and 3D, a wax fitting, then making. Rush orders are discussed separately.

items.q: Can you melt down my old gold?
items.a: Yes: we weigh it and test the fineness in front of you, and credit the metal's value towards the new piece.
One year on stone settings and clasps; free cleaning and polishing for life.
You can drop into the boutique, but for choosing a diamond or a bespoke order it's best to book — a consultant will set aside an hour for you.
